scope: PRSN-04 person flag-code producer, map display consumer and resource mapping

evidence.serialization: prsn +0x4C loads into Person +0x9C with 0xFFFF normalized to runtime -1; save, copy and compare paths preserve it
evidence.generation: one generated family-name index 0..103 selects both the family-name resource and a parallel flag code
evidence.parallel_table: the 104-byte table contains 104 distinct codes in range 2..173
evidence.inheritance: new persons copy a nonempty flag code from a base person whose first two family-name bytes match, otherwise store no code
evidence.map_consumers: resolve_map_object_flag_glyph_code feeds both building and unit snapshots; normal owned buildings use the effective force leader and units use their active leader
evidence.resource_mapping: codes 0..185 select G_Name.s9 global image 543+code or 729+code; G_Name contains exactly two 186-image animated glyph sets, while G_Flag contains the 52 base flag images
evidence.resource_validation: workspace archive parsing found G_Flag=4 palettes/52 images and G_Name=2 palettes/372 images; exported code 1 visibly renders the character 阿

ida_changes.read_back: Producer names and comments remain visible. After the display batch save and forced recompile, both snapshot callers use resolve_map_object_flag_glyph_code, the phased-sprite initializer shows flag_glyph_resource_base_ids[variant]+code, and the unit flag initializer consumes snapshot +0x18/+0x1C.
